result:
I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it against a database.

It does three things to `exports.status`:
1. Sets any existing NULL rows to `'queued'`. The NOT NULL step would fail without this.
2. Sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. Sets the column to NOT NULL.

I left `001_init.sql` alone because migrations are append-only and it has already run in prod.

Setting a default only fixes inserts that leave `status` out. If some code path inserts an explicit NULL, the NOT NULL constraint will now make that insert fail. I didn't look for such a path.
